label: KGhost
description: Race against a ghost on your Karoo: a fixed-pace Ghost Pace or your own past self on a route, stitched into one continuous ghost. Shows the live time/distance gap on graphical and numeric data fields and draws the ghost's position on the map. Records each ride automatically and can import GPX/FIT ghosts dropped in /sdcard/KGhost. Keeps estimating during GPS dropouts. Needs All files access: grant it in the KGhost app so it can find your past rides.
releaseNotes: When you finish a route or cancel navigation mid-ride, the gap now keeps the same race going: same lead, same clock, no more jumping to a whole-ride number (a 1-minute deficit could suddenly read hours ahead). After the route KGhost keeps judging you against your pace on each gradient, or your Ghost Pace target, and when you are behind the distance shows how far ahead the ghost is at its pace. Switching to Fixed pace mid-ride now ends the race cleanly, the map ghost reappears when you reload a route you just finished, and the gap and its resume file stay consistent when the ride app reconnects.
